review: Whoever created this app needs to be FIRED!!!!! The Monopoly game section is a disaster. The in-app camera won't take pictures of the Monopoly codes. So then I tried to "Add Code Manually" and I can't even do that because it just goes back to the main Monopoly screen. What an absolute joke of an app. This has completely deterred me from visiting. I uninstalled the app and reinstalled it hoping that could be a fix and...nope! Guess what!! Can't even get into my account!! I'm done with you, McD!
